entry.title: ][✓ nobloat/poll
entry.content: nobloat/poll is a self-hostable single-binary Doodle alternative written in plain go with no further dependencies. It doesn't require a database, job queue, npm or node. It works without signups. Every poll is a single JSON file, the whole thing ships as one 3.5 MB binary, and a page loads ~27 KB (6.9 kB + 20 kB uncompressed JavaScript and CSS). You can use it at poll.nobloat.org. There is no "pro version" of it.

entry.title: Building a cross-platform translation system
entry.content: At zeitkapsl.eu, we're building a privacy-first, end-to-end encrypted photo storage app that runs across iOS, Android, desktop, and web. As we expand into European markets, localization became critical, but we quickly discovered that managing translations across multiple platforms with their different native formats was a nightmare.
